title: NeuralDMD: Interpretable Neural Representation of Dynamics from Sparse and Noisy Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2507.03094v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many challenges in scientific imaging involve solving ill-posed inverse problems, where the goal is to recover spatio-temporal fields from indirect, noisy, and highly sparse measurements - often without access to ground truth data or reliable simulators. To address this challenging scenario, we present NeuralDMD, an interpretable, untrained (per-instance) reconstruction framework that combines neural implicit representations with Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to reconstruct continuous spatio-temporal dynamics directly from measurements. NeuralDMD parameterizes DMD modes as continuous neural fields, and imposes a low-rank linear dynamics prior with spectral time evolution to enforce temporal continuity. This formulation enables both forecasting under sparsity, and yields interpretable modes and spectra. We find that NeuralDMD outperforms baselines on a wide variety of tasks: from weather data assimilation from sparse station

translated_title: NeuralDMD：从稀疏且含噪测量中获得可解释的动力学神经表示
translated_abstract: 科学成像中的许多挑战都涉及求解病态逆问题，其目标是从间接、含噪且高度稀疏的测量中恢复时空场——而且通常无法获得真值数据或可靠的模拟器。为应对这一困难场景，我们提出了NeuralDMD，这是一个可解释的、无需预先训练（针对每个实例）的重构框架，它将神经隐式表示与动态模态分解相结合，直接从测量数据中重构连续的时空动力学。NeuralDMD将DMD模态参数化为连续神经场，并通过谱时间演化施加低秩线性动力学先验，从而强制实现时间连续性。这一建模方式既能在稀疏条件下进行预测，又能产生可解释的模态和频谱。我们发现NeuralDMD在多种任务上都优于基线方法：包括从稀疏气象站数据进行的天气数据同化等。
tldr: 提出NeuralDMD框架，将神经隐式表示与动态模态分解（DMD）相结合，从稀疏含噪测量中重构出可解释的连续时空动力学，无需真值数据或模拟器，并在天气数据同化等多种任务上优于现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: NeuralDMD combines neural implicit representations with Dynamic Mode Decomposition to reconstruct interpretable continuous spatio-temporal dynamics directly from sparse and noisy measurements without ground truth or simulators, outperforming baselines on tasks such as weather data assimilation.
